items.summaryZh: F1前燃油流量计供应商Sentronics Holdings Ltd在美国得克萨斯州起诉德国制造商Allengra GmbH，称目前每辆F1赛车使用的传感器侵犯其专利。该诉讼于10月16日提交至美国得克萨斯州西区联邦地区法院，距奥斯汀美国大奖赛仅数日。

media.altZh: F1前燃油流量计供应商在美國大奖赛前起诉继任者 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: F1’s former fuel flow meter supplier sues its replacement ahead of US GP
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's former fuel flow meter supplier, Sentronics Holdings Ltd, has sued German manufacturer Allengra GmbH in Texas, claiming that the sensors now used by every F1 car infringe its patent. The case was filed on 16 October in the US District Court for the Western District of Texas, just days before the United States Grand Prix in Austin.
detailZh: F1前燃油流量计供应商在美國大奖赛前起诉继任者
Sentronics曾是国际汽联的燃油流量计供应商，供应至2025年，该公司称目前每辆F1赛车安装的传感器侵犯其专利
F1前燃油流量计供应商Sentronics Holdings Ltd在美国得克萨斯州将其继任者告上法庭。该公司称，目前锦标赛中每辆赛车使用的传感器侵犯其专利。
这家英国公司于10月16日在美国得克萨斯州西区联邦地区法院对德国制造商Allengra GmbH提起诉讼。此时距奥斯汀美国大奖赛仅数日。根据法院案卷，Sentronics已要求陪审团审理，并随起诉书提交了两份证据。
什么是燃油流量计？
燃油流量计测量到达每台发动机的燃油量，使国际汽联能够监管技术法规中规定的流量限制。国际汽联希望密切关注这一点，因为燃油流量的变化意味着内燃机产生的功率发生变化。
据PlanetF1报道的投诉内容，Sentronics在2018年至2025年期间是国际汽联的独家供应商，之后Allengra于2024年11月赢得了2026年至2030年的合同。两家公司如今正面交锋，Sentronics声称Allengra的流量计侵犯了其美国专利11,391,609，该专利于2022年7月授予Sentronics。
该专利名为“流量计”，涉及“一种用于测量车辆燃油流速的方法及相关流量计”。专利解释说，超声波流量计的工作原理是“超声波信号在流体中两点固定之间传播的时间，取决于信号是顺流方向还是逆流方向传播，顺流传播时信号传播更快”。Sentronics的方法向相反方向发送成对信号，并改变其相位来测量流量。
起诉书称，Sentronics 自己在 2024 年底的实验室测试确认了侵权行为。起诉书还称，Sentronics 根据保密协议与 FIA 分享了技术细节。
除了直接侵权外，Sentronics 还指控 Allengra 鼓励 FIA 和各车队在美国使用这些流量计，包括在奥斯汀、迈阿密和拉斯维加斯的比赛中。
起诉书声称该侵权行为是蓄意选择，并补充说 Allengra 已于 2025 年 8 月被告知该专利的欧洲版本。Sentronics 的律师于 2026 年 4 月发出了一封要求函，Allengra 的美国律师对此提出异议。
根据起诉书，FIA 确认于 2025 年 9 月 17 日收到了 Sentronics 早先的通知，并表示其内容已"正式记录在案"。
Sentronics 现在请求法院永久禁止 Allengra 在美国制造、销售或供应这些计量表。不出所料，该公司还寻求赔偿自 2022 年以来损失的利润和特许权使用费。事实上，它希望将赔偿金额提高三倍，因为它称侵权行为是故意的。
美国大奖赛会受到影响吗？
不会，比赛周末完全不会受到影响，因为 Sentronics 并未申请紧急禁令来阻止这些部件的使用，而基米·安东内利正在为他的冠军胜利而战。法院已被要求发出传票，这是送达案件的正常步骤。
detailEn: F1’s former fuel flow meter supplier sues its replacement ahead of US GP
Sentronics, the FIA’s fuel flow meter supplier until 2025, claims the sensors now fitted to every F1 car infringe its patent

Formula 1’s former fuel flow meter supplier, Sentronics Holdings Ltd, has taken its replacement to court in Texas. The company claims that the sensors now used by every car in the championship infringe its patent.

The British company filed the case against German manufacturer Allengra GmbH in the US District Court for the Western District of Texas on 16 October. This comes just days before the United States Grand Prix in Austin. According to the court docket, Sentronics has demanded a jury trial and filed two exhibits alongside its complaint.
What are fuel flow meters?

Fuel flow meters measure how much fuel reaches each engine, allowing the FIA to police the flow limits set out in the technical regulations. The FIA wants to keep an eye on this, because a change in fuel flow means a change in power produced by the internal combustion engine.

According to the complaint, as reported by PlanetF1, Sentronics was the FIA’s exclusive supplier from 2018 to 2025 before Allengra won the contract for 2026 to 2030 in November 2024. The two companies are now butting heads, as Sentronics claims Allengra’s meters infringe its US patent, 11,391,609, which was granted to Sentronics in July 2022.

The patent, titled "Flow meter", relates to "a method and an associated flow meter for measuring fuel flow rate in a vehicle". It explains that ultrasonic flow meters work on the principle that "the propagation time of ultrasonic signals travelling through a fluid between two fixed points varies depending on whether the signal travels in the direction of flow or against the direction of flow, with signals propagating more quickly when travelling with the flow". Sentronics' method sends pairs of signals in opposite directions and alters their phase to measure the flow.
The complaint says Sentronics’ own laboratory testing in late 2024 confirmed the infringement. It also says Sentronics shared technical details with the FIA under a non-disclosure agreement.
As well as direct infringement, Sentronics accuses Allengra of encouraging the FIA and the teams to use the meters in the United States, including at the races in Austin, Miami and Las Vegas.

The complaint alleges the infringement was a deliberate choice, adding that Allengra was told about the European version of the patent in August 2025. Sentronics’ lawyers sent a demand letter in April 2026, which Allengra’s US counsel disputed.
According to the complaint, the FIA confirmed receiving Sentronics’ earlier notice on 17 September 2025, saying its contents were "duly noted".

Sentronics is now asking the court to permanently ban Allengra from making, selling or supplying the meters in the US. Unsurprisingly, it is also seeking damages for lost profits and royalties dating back to as far as 2022. In fact, it wants those damages tripled because it says the infringement was wilful.
Will the US Grand Prix be affected?

No, the race weekend won't be affected at all as Sentronics hasn't asked for an emergency ban that would stop the usage of these parts as Kimi Antonelli fights for his championship win. The court has been asked to issue a summons, which is a normal step for serving the case.

items.originalTitle: Christian Horner: Kimi Antonelli has 'earned' the right to be Mercedes' number one
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳：基米·安东内利‘赢得’了成为梅赛德斯一号车手的权利
基米·安东内利正在朝着成为F1最年轻世界冠军迈进，并赢得了梅赛德斯选择他作为一号车手而非乔治·拉塞尔的权利
克里斯蒂安·霍纳认为即将成为F1世界冠军的基米·安东内利在2026年的统治表现后，‘赢得’了成为梅赛德斯绝对一号车手的权利
这位20岁的车手在本赛季剩余六轮比赛中领先队友乔治·拉塞尔102分，因此他可以在奥斯汀的下一场比赛中锁定冠军。
安东内利在F1的第二年里就取得了这样的成就，凭借14个领奖台，其中包括8个胜利，同时他在2026年作为夺冠热门的拉塞尔之上。
霍纳认为，如果另一支车队成为威胁，安东内利是领导统治力强大的梅赛德斯车队前进的人选，同时在一个关于车队是否应该优先考虑车手的持续辩论中。
霍纳在2005年至2025年担任车队老板期间，经常支持这种做法，首先是与四届世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔，然后是与另一位四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队在这段时间里一直处于领先地位。
例如，去年迈凯轮采取了截然不同的方法，奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂和最终冠军兰多·诺里斯受到了平等对待，但他们几乎被维斯塔潘击败。
或者，正如霍纳所说，1986年威廉姆斯为尼格尔·曼塞尔和纳尔逊·皮克特制造了赢得车队冠军的FW11赛车，他们输给了麦克拉伦的阿兰·普罗斯特的车手冠军。
曼塞尔赢得1986年冠军的希望，在澳大利亚决赛中因爆胎而戏剧性地结束。
“始终让每个人都满意是非常困难的，”霍纳对《Autosport》说。“你只需要诚实，并遵循‘好吧，这里的目的是什么’的原则。”
“最终，团队是第一位的，车手们最终是承包商。承诺两位车手能够赢得世界冠军是不现实的。
“最终，将会有一个车手在赛道上取得优势，他们都有同样的机会，他们都有同样的设备，但你在赛道上的表现决定了你在团队中的尊重和地位。”
“就像现在的基米·安东内利一样。他通过在赛道上的表现赢得了那个团队中的位置，如果他和来自另一个团队的对手之间发生了一场激烈的竞争，团队将不得不采取立场。”
“否则，他们可能会像威廉姆斯队当年在与曼塞尔和皮奎特对抗普罗斯特时那样，失去一项冠军。所以，这就是你如何设定你的赛车计划去比赛。”"
“红牛队总是选择一号车手的动机可能源于2010年，当时维特尔和他的队友马克·韦伯在争夺冠军时经常发生碰撞。”
它几乎让法拉利的费尔南多·阿隆索赢得了那个冠军，但随后从2011年开始，维特尔在韦伯头上确立了统治地位，维斯塔潘也在他的各个队友头上做了类似的事情。
红牛的一切都是围绕着维斯塔潘建立的。
‘在早期，我们是一个年轻的团队，我们刚开始赢比赛，然后随之而来的是胜利带来的所有压力和突然升高的期望，’霍纳补充道。
“媒体的审查和聚光灯都在你身上，一切都被分析到了极致，你只能坚持你的原则。”
“你不能让所有人都一直满意，做对车队最有利的事才是我的职责。”
"我的工作就是做到最好，为红牛车队效力，这意味着赢得比赛。”
detailEn: Christian Horner: Kimi Antonelli has 'earned' the right to be Mercedes' number one
Kimi Antonelli is on course to become F1's youngest world champion and earn the right for Mercedes to pick him as its number-one driver over George Russell
Christian Horner reckons the soon-to-be Formula 1 world champion Kimi Antonelli has ‘earned’ his right to become the outright number-one driver at Mercedes after a dominant 2026.
The 20-year-old holds a 102-point lead over team-mate George Russell in second with six rounds remaining this season, so he can clinch the title in Austin next time out.
Antonelli has achieved this in only his second year of F1 and thanks to 14 podiums including eight wins, while he has had the upper hand on Russell who entered 2026 as the title favourite.
So Horner thinks Antonelli is the man to lead the dominant Mercedes forwards if another squad becomes a threat, amid an ongoing debate over whether teams should prioritise a driver.
Horner’s Red Bull outfit was often in favour of this during his time as team boss from 2005 to 2025, first with Sebastian Vettel and then Max Verstappen - both of whom won four world titles each.
McLaren, for example, had a contrasting approach last year with Oscar Piastri and eventual champion Lando Norris, who were given equal treatment but almost beaten by Verstappen.
Or, as referred to by Horner, in 1986 when Williams produced the constructors’ title-winning FW11 for Nigel Mansell and Nelson Piquet, who lost the drivers’ crown to McLaren’s Alain Prost.
Mansell's hopes of winning the 1986 title dramatically ended with an exploding tyre at the Australia finale
“It's very hard to keep everybody happy all the time,” Horner told Autosport. “You’ve just got to be honest and with the principles of ‘okay, what are the objectives here’.
“At the end of the day, the team is what comes first and the drivers are ultimately contractors. To promise both drivers that you can be able to win a world championship is unrealistic.

“Ultimately there will be one driver that achieves superiority on track and they're both given the same chance, they're both given the same equipment, but you earn the respect and a status within a team by what you do on a track.

“It’s like Kimi Antonelli at the moment. He's earning that position in that team by what he's doing on circuit and if there came to a tight fight between him and a rival from another team, the team would have to take a stance.
“Otherwise they risk losing a championship in the way that Williams potentially did with Mansell and Piquet against Prost all those years ago. So it's just how you set your stall out to go racing.”
The motivation behind Red Bull always picking a number one perhaps stemmed from 2010 when Vettel and team-mate Mark Webber often collided while vying for the title.
It almost led to Ferrari’s Fernando Alonso clinching that championship, but then from 2011 Vettel asserted dominance over Webber with Verstappen doing similar over his various team-mates.
Everything at Red Bull is built around Verstappen
“What it taught me in the early days, we were a young team, we just started winning and then all the pressures that go with winning and the expectations suddenly rise,” added Horner.
“The media scrutiny and the spotlight is on you, everything is being analysed to the nth degree and you've just got to stick to your principles.
“You can't keep everybody happy all of the time and it's doing what is best for the team.
"That's what my job was, I was employed to do the best for Red Bull Racing which meant winning.”
